typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet = CAST(CONCAT(UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,\'|\',CLAIM_NUMBER,\'|\',CLAIM_LINE,\'|\',CLAIM_TYPE,\'|\',PAID_STATUS,\'|\',PLACE_OF_SERVICE_CODE,\'|\',PLACE_OF_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION,\'|\', 						  BEGINNING_DATE_OF_SERVICE,\'|\',ENDING_DATE_OF_SERVICE,\'|\',PROVIDER_NPI,\'|\',FACILITY_NPI ,\'|\',DRG,\'|\',CODE_TYPE,\'|\',ADMISSION_FROM_DATE,\'|\',ADMISSION_TO_DATE,\'|\', 						  ADMISSION_SOURCE,\'|\',ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE,\'|\',DISCHARGE_TYPE_CODE,\'|\',BILL_TYPE,\'|\',REVENUE_CODE,\'|\',PCP_INDICATOR,\'|\',PAID_AMOUNT,\'|\',BILLED_AMOUNT,\'|\',COPAY_AMOUNT,\'|\', 						  COINSURANCE_AMOUNT,\'|\',DEDUCTIBLE,\'|\',PAID_DATE) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 		FROM EXTRACT.MINDOULA_STAGE_MEDCLMS_DIAG_PROCCODES WHERE (GRGR_CK = ? OR ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\') 		GROUP BY UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,CLAIM_NUMBER,CLAIM_LINE,CLAIM_TYPE,PAID_STATUS,PLACE_OF_SERVICE_CODE,PLACE_OF_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION,BEGINNING_DATE_OF_SERVICE, 				 ENDING_DATE_OF_SERVICE,PROVIDER_NPI,FACILITY_NPI ,DRG,CODE_TYPE,ADMISSION_FROM_DATE,ADMISSION_TO_DATE,ADMISSION_SOURCE,ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE,DISCHARGE_TYPE_CODE, 				 BILL_TYPE,REVENUE_CODE,PCP_INDICATOR,PAID_AMOUNT,BILLED_AMOUNT,COPAY_AMOUNT,COINSURANCE_AMOUNT,DEDUCTIBLE,PAID_DATE,ROW_INDICATOR 		ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetMedicalClaimsData
GetMedicalClaimsData derive(ResultSet = ResultSet) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> MedClaimsFileOutbound
